params.rate_desc: No tax on wages. Prior law imposed the interest and dividends tax at 3% on interest and dividends over a $2,400 personal or $4,800 joint exemption (TIR 2025-001)
params.rate_desc_2018: No tax on wages. The interest and dividends tax is 5% on interest and dividends over a $2,400 personal or $4,800 joint exemption (Form DP-10 instructions).
params.rate_desc_2023: No tax on wages. The interest and dividends tax is 4% on interest and dividends over a $2,400 personal or $4,800 joint exemption (Form DP-10 instructions).
params.rate_desc_2024: No tax on wages. The interest and dividends tax is 3% on interest and dividends over a $2,400 personal or $4,800 joint exemption (Form DP-10 instructions).
params.rate_desc_2025: No tax on wages. The interest and dividends tax is repealed for taxable periods beginning after December 31, 2024 (TIR 2025-001)

not_recorded.reason: TIR 2025-001 states the $2,400 / $4,800 exemptions as prior law and repeals the tax for periods beginning after December 31, 2024. It does not state a 2025 exemption.
